+ // Zod schemas for runtime type validation
+ const GanttTaskSchema = z.object({
+   id: z.string(),
+   text: z.string(),
+   start_date: z.string(),
+   duration: z.number(),
+   progress: z.number(),
+   agent: z.string(),
+   dependencies: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
+   color: z.string().optional(),
+   parent: z.string().optional(),
+ });
+ 
+ const KanbanCardSchema = z.object({
+   id: z.string(),
+   title: z.string(),
+   description: z.string(),
+   agent: z.string(),
+   status: z.enum([&#39;backlog&#39;, &#39;todo&#39;, &#39;in_progress&#39;, &#39;review&#39;, &#39;done&#39;]),
+   priority: z.enum([&#39;lowest&#39;, &#39;low&#39;, &#39;medium&#39;, &#39;high&#39;, &#39;highest&#39;]),
+   dueDate: z.string().optional(),
+   tags: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
+   assignee: z.string().optional(),
+   createdAt: z.string(),
+   updatedAt: z.string(),
+ });
+ 
+ const ProjectTaskSchema = z.object({
+   id: z.string(),
+   name: z.string(),
+   assignedAgent: z.string(),
+   status: z.enum([&#39;not_started&#39;, &#39;planning&#39;, &#39;in_progress&#39;, &#39;on_hold&#39;, &#39;review&#39;, &#39;completed&#39;, &#39;cancelled&#39;]),
+   progress: z.number(),
+   startDate: z.string(),
+   endDate: z.string(),
+   duration: z.number(),
+   priority: z.enum([&#39;lowest&#39;, &#39;low&#39;, &#39;medium&#39;, &#39;high&#39;, &#39;highest&#39;]),
+   qualityScore: z.number(),
+   dependencies: z.array(z.string()),
+   tags: z.array(z.string()),
+ });
+ 
+ /**
+  * Generic invoke wrapper with Zod for type-safe command calls
+  */
+ async function invokeTyped&lt;T&gt;(
+   commandName: string,
+   args: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;,
+   outputSchema: z.ZodType&lt;T&gt;,
+ ): Promise&lt;T&gt; {
+   const result = await invoke(commandName, args);
+   return outputSchema.parse(result);
+ }
+ 
+ // =============================================================================
+ // Gantt Chart Commands
+ // =============================================================================
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get Gantt tasks for a project
+  */
+ export async function getGanttTasks(projectId: string): Promise&lt;readonly GanttTask[]&gt; {
+   return invokeTyped(
+     &#39;get_gantt_tasks&#39;,
+     { projectId },
+     z.array(GanttTaskSchema),
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Update Gantt task
+  */
+ export async function updateGanttTask(taskId: string, updates: Partial&lt;GanttTask&gt;): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   await invoke(&#39;update_gantt_task&#39;, { taskId, updates });
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Create Gantt task
+  */
+ export async function createGanttTask(task: Omit&lt;GanttTask, &#39;id&#39;&gt;): Promise&lt;GanttTask&gt; {
+   return invokeTyped(
+     &#39;create_gantt_task&#39;,
+     { task },
+     GanttTaskSchema,
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Delete Gantt task
+  */
+ export async function deleteGanttTask(taskId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   await invoke(&#39;delete_gantt_task&#39;, { taskId });
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get Gantt links (dependencies)
+  */
+ export async function getGanttLinks(projectId: string): Promise&lt;readonly GanttLink[]&gt; {
+   return invokeTyped(
+     &#39;get_gantt_links&#39;,
+     { projectId },
+     z.array(z.object({
+       id: z.string(),
+       source: z.string(),
+       target: z.string(),
+       type: z.enum([&#39;finish_to_start&#39;, &#39;start_to_start&#39;, &#39;finish_to_finish&#39;, &#39;start_to_finish&#39;]),
+     })),
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Create Gantt link
+  */

+

+     try {
+       setLoading(true);
+       setError(null);
+ 
+       const kanbanBoard = await getKanbanBoard(projectId);
+       setBoard(kanbanBoard);
+     } catch (err) {
+       setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : &#39;Failed to load Kanban board&#39;);
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);

+

+     try {
+       await updateKanbanCard(cardId, updates);
+ 
+       // Update local state
+       if (board) {
+         setBoard(prevBoard =&gt; ({
+           ...prevBoard!,
+           cards: prevBoard!.cards.map(card =&gt;
+             card.id === cardId ? { ...card, ...updates } : card
+           ),
+         }));
+       }
+ 
+       const updatedCard = board?.cards.find(c =&gt; c.id === cardId);
+       if (updatedCard) {
+         onCardUpdate?.({ ...updatedCard, ...updates });
+       }
+     } catch (err) {
+       setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : &#39;Failed to update card&#39;);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleCardCreate = async (column: KanbanColumn) =&gt; {
+     try {
+       const newCard: Omit&lt;KanbanCard, &#39;id&#39; | &#39;createdAt&#39; | &#39;updatedAt&#39;&gt; = {
+         title: &#39;New Card&#39;,
+         description: &#39;&#39;,
+         agent: &#39;unassigned&#39;,
+         status: column,
+         priority: &#39;medium&#39;,
+       };
+ 
+       const createdCard = await createKanbanCard(newCard);
+ 
+       if (board) {
+         setBoard(prevBoard =&gt; ({
+           ...prevBoard!,
+           cards: [...prevBoard!.cards, createdCard],
+         }));
+       }
+     } catch (err) {
+       setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : &#39;Failed to create card&#39;);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleCardDelete = async (cardId: string) =&gt; {
+     try {
+       await deleteKanbanCard(cardId);
+ 
+       if (board) {
+         setBoard(prevBoard =&gt; ({
+           ...prevBoard!,
+           cards: prevBoard!.cards.filter(card =&gt; card.id !== cardId),
+         }));

+ 
+       if (selectedCard?.id === cardId) {

+ #[tauri::command]
+ async fn get_dashboard_metrics(
+     state: State&lt;&#39;_, OrchestratorState&gt;,
+ ) -&gt; Result&lt;serde_json::Value, String&gt; {
+     let orchestrator = state.orchestration.orchestrator.read().await;
+     let progress = orchestrator.get_progress().await;
+ 
+     let total_tasks = progress.len();
+     let active_tasks = progress.values().filter(|p| p.is_active()).count();
+     let completed_tasks = progress.values().filter(|p| p.is_completed()).count();
+     let failed_tasks = progress.values().filter(|p| p.is_failed()).count();
+ 
+     // Calculate quality score (placeholder - would need real quality analysis)
+     let quality_score = 0.85;
+ 
+     // Get resource capacity for performance score
+     let capacity = orchestrator.get_resource_capacity().await
+         .map_err(|e| format!(&quot;Failed to get capacity: {}&quot;, e))?;
+     let active_percentage = if capacity.max_concurrent &gt; 0 {
+         capacity.active_tasks as f64 / capacity.max_concurrent as f64
+     } else {
+         0.0
+     };
+     let performance_score = 1.0 - active_percentage;
+ 
+     let active_agents = capacity.active_tasks;
+ 
+     Ok(serde_json::json!({
+         &quot;totalTasks&quot;: total_tasks,
+         &quot;activeTasks&quot;: active_tasks,
+         &quot;completedTasks&quot;: completed_tasks,
+         &quot;failedTasks&quot;: failed_tasks,
+         &quot;qualityScore&quot;: quality_score,
+         &quot;performanceScore&quot;: performance_score,
+         &quot;resourceUtilization&quot;: active_percentage,
+         &quot;activeAgents&quot;: active_agents,
+     }))
+ }
+ 
+ #[tauri::command]
+ async fn get_system_status(
+     state: State&lt;&#39;_, OrchestratorState&gt;,
+ ) -&gt; Result&lt;serde_json::Value, String&gt; {
+     let orchestrator = state.orchestration.orchestrator.read().await;
+     let progress = orchestrator.get_progress().await;
+ 
+     // Overall health based on task status
+     let total_tasks = progress.len();
+     let failed_tasks = progress.values().filter(|p| p.is_failed()).count();
+     let active_tasks = progress.values().filter(|p| p.is_active()).count();
+ 
+     let overall_health = if failed_tasks &gt; 0 {
+         &quot;critical&quot;
+     } else if active_tasks == 0 &amp;&amp; total_tasks &gt; 0 {
+         &quot;warning&quot;
+     } else {
+         &quot;healthy&quot;
+     };
+ 
+     // Component status
+     let capacity = orchestrator.get_resource_capacity().await
+         .map_err(|e| format!(&quot;Failed to get capacity: {}&quot;, e))?;
+ 
+     let mcp_bridge = state.orchestration.mcp_bridge.read().await;
+     let mcp_servers = mcp_bridge.list_servers().await;
+     let connected_servers = mcp_servers.iter().filter(|s| s.status == &quot;Connected&quot;).count();
+     let total_servers = mcp_servers.len();
+ 
+     let components = serde_json::json!({
+         &quot;orchestrator&quot;: if active_tasks &gt; 0 { &quot;healthy&quot; } else { &quot;idle&quot; },
+         &quot;mcp_bridge&quot;: if connected_servers &gt; 0 { &quot;healthy&quot; } else if total_servers &gt; 0 { &quot;warning&quot; } else { &quot;offline&quot; },
+         &quot;resources&quot;: if capacity.available_slots &gt; 0 { &quot;healthy&quot; } else { &quot;critical&quot; },
+         &quot;worktrees&quot;: &quot;healthy&quot; // Placeholder
+     });
+ 
+     // Generate alerts
+     let mut alerts = Vec::new();
+ 
+     if failed_tasks &gt; 0 {
+         alerts.push(serde_json::json!({
+             &quot;id&quot;: &quot;failed_tasks&quot;,
+             &quot;type&quot;: &quot;error&quot;,
+             &quot;title&quot;: &quot;Task Failures&quot;,
+             &quot;message&quot;: format!(&quot;{} tasks have failed&quot;, failed_tasks),
+             &quot;timestamp&quot;: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339()
+         }));
+     }
+ 
+     if capacity.available_slots == 0 {
+         alerts.push(serde_json::json!({
+             &quot;id&quot;: &quot;resource_exhaustion&quot;,
+             &quot;type&quot;: &quot;warning&quot;,
+             &quot;title&quot;: &quot;Resource Exhaustion&quot;,
+             &quot;message&quot;: &quot;All available task slots are in use&quot;,
+             &quot;timestamp&quot;: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339()
+         }));
+     }
+ 
+     if connected_servers == 0 &amp;&amp; total_servers &gt; 0 {
+         alerts.push(serde_json::json!({
+             &quot;id&quot;: &quot;mcp_disconnected&quot;,
+             &quot;type&quot;: &quot;info&quot;,
+             &quot;title&quot;: &quot;MCP Servers&quot;,
+             &quot;message&quot;: &quot;No MCP servers are currently connected&quot;,
+             &quot;timestamp&quot;: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339()
+         }));
+     }
+ 
+     Ok(serde_json::json!({
+         &quot;overallHealth&quot;: overall_health,
+         &quot;components&quot;: components,
+         &quot;alerts&quot;: alerts
+     }))
+ }
+ 
+ #[tauri::command]
+ async fn get_worktree_status(
+     state: State&lt;&#39;_, OrchestratorState&gt;,
+ ) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;, String&gt; {
+     let orchestrator = state.orchestration.orchestrator.read().await;
+ 
+     // Get worktree manager status
+     // This would need to be implemented in the orchestrator
+     // For now, return empty array as placeholder
+     let worktrees = Vec::new();
+ 
+     Ok(worktrees)
+ }
  
  #[tokio::main]
```

import { BrowserRouter as Router, Routes, Route, Link } from &quot;react-router-dom&quot;;
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from &quot;react&quot;;
import { listen } from &quot;@tauri-apps/api/event&quot;;
import { writeText, readText } from &quot;@tauri-apps/api/clipboard&quot;;
import Dashboard from &quot;./pages/Dashboard&quot;;
import Settings from &quot;./pages/Settings&quot;;
import Plans from &quot;./pages/Plans&quot;;
import GitVR from &quot;./pages/GitVR&quot;;
import Orchestration from &quot;./pages/Orchestration&quot;;
import { CyberpunkBackground } from &quot;./components/CyberpunkBackground&quot;;
import &quot;./App.css&quot;;
import &quot;./styles/cyberpunk-theme.css&quot;;

function App() {
  const [selectedText, setSelectedText] = useState&lt;string&gt;(&quot;&quot;);
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState&lt;string&gt;(&quot;&quot;);

  // Clipboard operations
  const handleCopy = useCallback(async (text?: string) =&gt; {
    try {
      const textToCopy = text || selectedText || window.getSelection()?.toString() || &quot;&quot;;                                                                       
      if (textToCopy) {
        await writeText(textToCopy);
        setNotification(&quot;搭 Copied to clipboard&quot;);
        setTimeout(() =&gt; setNotification(&quot;&quot;), 2000);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(&quot;Failed to copy:&quot;, error);
    }
  }, [selectedText]);

  const handlePaste = useCallback(async () =&gt; {
    try {
      const text = await readText();
      return text || &quot;&quot;;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(&quot;Failed to paste:&quot;, error);
      return &quot;&quot;;
    }
  }, []);

  // Keyboard shortcuts
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    const handleKeyDown = async (e: KeyboardEvent) =&gt; {
      // Ctrl+C / Cmd+C - Copy
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) &amp;&amp; e.key === &#39;c&#39;) {
        const selection = window.getSelection()?.toString();
        if (selection) {
          e.preventDefault();
          await handleCopy(selection);
        }
      }

      // Ctrl+V / Cmd+V - Paste (handled by individual components)
      // Can be extended per component as needed
    };

    window.addEventListener(&#39;keydown&#39;, handleKeyDown);
    return () =&gt; window.removeEventListener(&#39;keydown&#39;, handleKeyDown);
  }, [handleCopy]);

  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    // Listen for navigation events from tray
    const unlisten = listen&lt;string&gt;(&quot;navigate&quot;, (event) =&gt; {
      const path = event.payload;
      window.location.hash = path;
    });

    return () =&gt; {
      unlisten.then((fn) =&gt; fn());
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    &lt;Router&gt;
      &lt;CyberpunkBackground /&gt;
      {notification &amp;&amp; (
        &lt;div className=&quot;cyberpunk-notification&quot;&gt;
          {notification}
        &lt;/div&gt;
      )}
      &lt;div className=&quot;app-container cyberpunk-container&quot;&gt;
        &lt;nav className=&quot;sidebar&quot;&gt;
          &lt;div className=&quot;logo&quot;&gt;
            &lt;h2&gt;Codex AI&lt;/h2&gt;
            &lt;p className=&quot;version&quot;&gt;v1.5.0&lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;

          &lt;div className=&quot;nav-links&quot;&gt;
            &lt;Link to=&quot;/&quot; className=&quot;nav-link&quot;&gt;
              投 Dashboard
            &lt;/Link&gt;
            &lt;Link to=&quot;/git-viz&quot; className=&quot;nav-link&quot;&gt;
              倹 Git Visualization
            &lt;/Link&gt;
            &lt;Link to=&quot;/orchestration&quot; className=&quot;nav-link&quot;&gt;
              鹿 Orchestration
            &lt;/Link&gt;
            &lt;Link to=&quot;/Plans&quot; className=&quot;nav-link&quot;&gt;
              搭 Plans
            &lt;/Link&gt;
            &lt;Link to=&quot;/settings&quot; className=&quot;nav-link&quot;&gt;
              笞呻ｸ・Settings
            &lt;/Link&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;

          &lt;div className=&quot;nav-footer&quot;&gt;
            &lt;p&gt;AI Native OS&lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/nav&gt;

        &lt;main className=&quot;main-content&quot;&gt;
          &lt;Routes&gt;
            &lt;Route path=&quot;/&quot; element={&lt;Dashboard /&gt;} /&gt;
            &lt;Route path=&quot;/git-viz&quot; element={&lt;GitVR /&gt;} /&gt;
            &lt;Route path=&quot;/orchestration&quot; element={&lt;Orchestration /&gt;} /&gt;
            &lt;Route path=&quot;/Plans&quot; element={&lt;Plans /&gt;} /&gt;
            &lt;Route path=&quot;/settings&quot; element={&lt;Settings /&gt;} /&gt;
          &lt;/Routes&gt;
        &lt;/main&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/Router&gt;
  );
}

export default App;
```

    }

}

const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

const { platform, arch } = process;

//! Codex CLI - AI-Native OS Command Line Interface

use std::process::Command;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    
    if args.len() < 2 {
        print_help();
        return Ok(());
    }

    match args[1].as_str() {
        "tui" => launch_tui(),
        "gui" => launch_gui(),
        "--help" | "-h" => {
            print_help();
            Ok(())
        }
        _ => {
            eprintln!("Unknown command: {}", args[1]);
            print_help();
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

fn launch_tui() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    println!("Launching Terminal User Interface...");
    
    let tui_path = std::env::current_exe()?
        .parent()
        .unwrap()
        .join("codex-tui");

    match Command::new(tui_path).spawn() {
        Ok(mut child) => {
            println!("TUI launched successfully (PID: {})", child.id());
            let status = child.wait()?;
            println!("TUI exited with status: {}", status);
        }
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("Failed to launch TUI: {}", e);
            eprintln!("Please ensure the TUI application is installed.");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn launch_gui() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    println!("Launching Graphical User Interface...");
    
    let gui_path = std::env::current_exe()?
        .parent()
        .unwrap()
        .join("codex-tauri-gui");

    match Command::new(gui_path).spawn() {
        Ok(mut child) => {
            println!("GUI launched successfully (PID: {})", child.id());
            let status = child.wait()?;
            println!("GUI exited with status: {}", status);
        }
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("Failed to launch GUI: {}", e);
            eprintln!("Please ensure the GUI application is installed.");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn print_help() {
    println!("Codex AI-Native OS v2.2.0");
    println!("");
    println!("USAGE:");
    println!("    codex [COMMAND]");
    println!("");
    println!("COMMANDS:");
    println!("    tui     Launch Terminal User Interface");
    println!("    gui     Launch Graphical User Interface");
    println!("    --help  Show this help message");
}
